title: ESPN SAYS YAMAL IS THE BEST IN THE WORLD. THE BALLON D'OR WINNER IS FIFTH!
description:
ESPN has ranked its top ten players in the world, and Lamine Yamal is first.

Bellingham is second and Olise is third. Raphinha is fourth. Then comes the big one: Kane, the reigning Ballon d'Or winner, is fifth. That is down from fourth, and ESPN notes a finishing slump.

Mbappe is sixth and Pedri is ninth, which means Barcelona have three players in the top ten. Not one Dortmund player makes the list.

ESPN also says Yamal improved his shot quality this season. Kane could borrow his notebook.
